facts.fact: Loi de finances n°25/060 of 29 December 2025 appropriates FC 81,698,223,741 of domestic state money for Section 71, Economie Numerique, for budget year 2026 (section total FC 226,713,223,741 less FC 145,015,000,000 external investment).

The document states Section 71 rose from FC 60,627,481,411 in 2025 to FC 226,713,223,741 in 2026 (+274%), all sources; the domestic share rose from FC 60,627,481,411 to FC 81,698,223,741; the document adds that part of the jump is a transfer of mandate from Section 52.
